_comment: Experiment 1 of the bank-wiggle queue: loss design. simple-v1's true-time-position objective scores POSITION only, and the converged baseline's chart-velocity error measures 24.12 m/s RMS - completely unconstrained. These arms are a dose-response on a velocity term, weighted against the MEASURED baseline operating point (position term 0.009055, raw velocity term 5.815438, ratio 642x), so 0.0008 makes velocity ~0.5x position and 0.003 makes it ~2x. The control-effort knob is deliberately NOT an arm: its scale divides load factor by its upper bound, so it would penalise the n~1 that level flight requires far harder than the spurious bank.
